packageRules.description: Seven's pins: every @ai-ecoverse package in the base set (src/packages), the optional catalog (src/packages/optional) and /opt/agent (src/packages/agent) bumps by itself, with its npm and pnpm lockfiles. The automerge goes through the merge queue, and ci / test passes on a Renovate PR only once cert review certified every package it changes (scripts/ci/certified.mjs). For a gated package, cert review's queue job adds the certified certs.json lines to the PR and runs CI again.
homescoop's packages (wasi-*, wasix-*, wasm-*, py-*, wasi-pnpm included) come as one PR a day, which cert review certifies package by package.
The kernel gets its own PR, the base set's and /opt/agent's pins together (pins.test wants them equal), not grouped with pnpm as the shared preset does.
Held: wasm-bash 5.3.0-20 and later need a kernel with slicc-kernel#1146 (ai-ecoverse/slicc-kernel#1146). Drop this rule in the PR that pins that kernel.
Skipped: wasi-pnpm 12.9.1-11 and 12.9.1-12 are deprecated, since installs can fail with rename timeouts on OPFS (ai-ecoverse/homescoop#1128). Use 12.9.1-13 or later.
The grammars and Tailscale projects (src/packages/grammars, src/packages/tailscale) are pinned by hand: Renovate lists them on the dependency dashboard and opens a PR only when one is ticked there.
